nodes.label: Canvas UI
nodes.notes: React app: chat left, Excalidraw canvas right. App.jsx wires state, Chat.jsx reads the SSE stream, Canvas.jsx + graphToScene.js render the graph and save layout, Inspector/ScanPanel/Nav edit workspace, node and scan state. Not an editor — no file tree, no diffs.

nodes.label: Express server
nodes.notes: All HTTP routes: /api/workspaces, /api/sessions, /api/graph, /api/nodes, /api/edges, /api/scan, /api/pick-folder, and /api/chat which runs the Agent SDK turn and streams it back over SSE.

nodes.label: Canvas MCP tools
nodes.notes: In-process SDK MCP server exposing get_graph, get_node and patch_graph, plus set_layout (box positions and arrow routes) on an Arrange turn only. Rebuilt per turn with the active workspace dir closed over, so the agent can only touch that repo's graph.

nodes.label: Graph store
nodes.notes: Per-workspace <dir>/.promptcanvas/graph.json. applyPatch strips x/y/w/h so structure stays the agent's and layout stays the user's; also does free-slot auto-placement and PR-friendly serialisation.

nodes.label: Repo scanner
nodes.notes: Evidence-based draft diagram from compose services, package/composer manifests and workspace packages. No LLM, no network. Never derives nodes from the folder tree.

nodes.label: Workspace registry
nodes.notes: ~/.promptcanvas/workspaces.json — the repo list plus active workspace/session. The only state living outside the projects it drives. Atomic writes with a .bak.

nodes.label: Native folder dialog
nodes.notes: Spawns the OS folder chooser server-side to back the Browse… button when adding a workspace.

nodes.label: Claude Agent SDK
nodes.notes: query() runs the turn against the Anthropic API and owns the session store the picker lists. Reached only from /api/chat; needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in .env.
